title: UAAP: UE, NUNS boys complete HS volleyball Final 4 cast
summary: University of the East and National University Nazareth School scored crucial victories on Sunday to complete the Final 4 cast of the UAAP Season 89 boys' volleyball tournament at the Blue Eagle Gym.
